title: Change adopt --dry-run refuses an unsupported import source as adoption does
description: change adopt --dry-run refuses an unsupported import source as adoption does
no_spec_change_rationale: change adopt documents --dry-run as a preview of adoption and --source as openspec or speckit; the preview accepted any source and claimed it would import from it, while adoption refuses it as unsupported (#432)
acceptance_criteria: change adopt --dry-run --source bogus exits nonzero with unsupported adoption source and prints no import plan, exactly as change adopt --source bogus does; a dry run with a supported or detected source still prints its plan and writes nothing
